name: Sun Rock Retreat
summary: Atop the central Stonetalon peaks, Sun Rock Retreat shelters the Horde south of Mirkfallon Lake. Tauren hold the mountain sacred, while orcs and tauren use the settlement as a base and supply post.

sections.title: A Sacred Haven in the Peaks
sections.body: Sun Rock Retreat lies in a mountain basin south of Mirkfallon Lake, on ground the tauren have long held sacred. Ancient tradition says An'she, the Sun, kissed the peak above the village. For generations before the Horde came, tauren shamans and pilgrims traveled here for rites that crossed the mortal veil. They drew strength from the land's close bond with the spirit world.

sections.title: Frontier Outpost
sections.body: Orcs and tauren now hold Sun Rock Retreat as the Horde's chief base across the Stonetalon Mountains. Together they seek a secure foothold against hostile harpy broods, local night elf sentinels, and the Venture Company's industrial pillaging. Trade and flight routes link the retreat with Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, and the borders of Ashenvale. The outpost offers shelter, provisions, and spiritual guidance to those who brave the crags.

faq.answer: Sun Rock Retreat is the Horde's main outpost in the Stonetalon Mountains. Mostly tauren and orcs live there, and it is a sanctuary, trading station, and command post for Horde champions in the region.

faq.q: Why is this place sacred to the tauren?
faq.answer: Tauren legend says An'she, the Sun, touched the mountain where Sun Rock Retreat now stands. Its enduring bond with the spirit world has made the land a pilgrimage site for visions and communion with ancestors.

faq.q: What threats does the retreat face?
faq.answer: The retreat faces aggressive harpies, hostile night elves guarding the sacred woods, and the Venture Company's destructive mining and logging, which ravage the land.

faq.q: Where does the local flight master connect?
faq.answer: Wind riders from Sun Rock Retreat connect travelers with major central Kalimdor destinations, including the Crossroads in the Barrens and Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital.

angles.text: To the shu'halo, Sun Rock Retreat is sacred ground blessed by An'she, where shamans have walked the spirit realm for centuries.
Sun Rock Retreat is the Horde's main staging hub in the Stonetalon Mountains, with supplies and flight routes among contested peaks.
